SourceTerm: 近山無柴燒，近水無水喫

Senses.PreferredTarget: near the mountain there is no firewood to burn and near the water there is no water to drink
SearchAliases: near water without water to drink
Senses.Note: No Tier 1 or Tier 2 transport survives. The best useful lamp is retained as provisional last-resort support.

Occurrences.Kwic: 此子向後若有箇住處，近山無柴燒，近水無水喫。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X66/X66n1297.xml). Grove of the Mirror of the School. The lamp transmits Guishan Lingyou’s prediction.

Senses.Explanation: Near the mountain there is no firewood to burn and near the water there is no water to drink is Guishan Lingyou’s prediction about a future residence, not geographic advice. Only a lamp recension survives in the collected corpus, so it remains provisional.
